unit_of_observation: one fictional eligible student completing one standardized library-search task
recruitment: synthetic illustrative eligible cohort, not sampled from a real student population
assignment_mechanism: independent Bernoulli(0.50) assignment to the redesigned or standard interface
target_estimand: mean task_score(1) minus task_score(0) in the randomized fictional cohort, where 1 and 0 are the specified redesigned and standard interface assignments
warning: The hidden simulator effect is not an observed result and is not evidence about students or interfaces outside this fictional protocol.

structural_equations.task_score: task_score_0 if redesigned_interface=0; task_score_1 if redesigned_interface=1

missing_value_code: none; all six CSV fields are complete

variables.name: difficult_task
variables.role: pre-assignment task stratum and precision covariate

variables.name: clicks_during_task
variables.role: post-assignment navigation behavior; not a primary adjustment variable

latent_variables_not_in_csv: shared task-score noise defining both potential scores
site_or_time_variables: single fictional institution and immediate outcome period
